provenance: Two generations of lessons exist, and they were written differently. The first lessons (functions, vectors, matrices, derivatives, gradients, chain rule, gradient descent, losses, layers, backpropagation, training, autograd, linear regression, logistic regression, generalisation, k-means, PCA) were written from general knowledge, and the library files they list are pointers to where your material treats the same topic: their chapters were NOT read line by line (marked 'pointer only' below). Every later lesson was written after opening and reading the cited pages or files (marked 'read'), with page numbers recorded; explanations are in original words, nothing is quoted at length. In all cases every number, worked example and exercise solution was checked by running code (bun run verify:content). The first-generation lessons will be re-checked against their sources as time allows. External references are cited from memory, not retrieved: verify before relying on them.
